meta.title: Install Ostinara on your phone
meta.description: Add Ostinara to your iPhone or Android home screen in a minute, and turn on notifications.

title: Ostinara on your <accent>phone</accent>
lead: No app store: you add it from your browser to your home screen, with its icon and its notifications.

installed.title: It's already installed
installed.body: You're in the app. For notifications, always open Ostinara from its icon.

desktop.title: You're on a computer
desktop.body: Open this address on your phone, then follow the steps below:

notSafari.title: Open this page in Safari
notSafari.body: On iPhone, only Safari can add Ostinara to the home screen. Copy the link and paste it into Safari.

safari.title: Open the link in Safari
safari.body: It has to be Safari, not Chrome or another app's built-in browser.

dots.title: Tap the three dots
dots.body: On the right of the address bar, at the bottom of the screen.

share.title: Tap Share
share.body: On older iPhones, the Share button sits right at the bottom of the screen.

home.title: Pick “Add to Home Screen”
home.body: Scroll down the list a bit if you don't see it.

add.title: Tap Add
add.body: Keep “Open as Web App” switched on.

open.title: Open Ostinara from the icon
open.body: Always from the icon, not from Safari: that's where notifications work.

notif.title: Turn on notifications
notif.body: Tap Turn on under “Turn on reminders?”, then Allow.

android.title: On Android
android.buttonHint: Your browser offers a one-tap install.

chrome.title: Open the link in Chrome
chrome.body: Or in your phone's browser (Samsung Internet works too).

install.title: Pick “Install app”
install.body: Depending on the phone, it's “Add to Home screen”, then “Install”.

notif.title: Open the app and turn on notifications
notif.body: From the icon, tap Turn on under “Turn on reminders?”, then Allow.

after.title: What's next?
after.body: Sign in, add a song or an album you listened to, and invite your friends. You can turn notifications on or off in Profile › Settings.

landing.title: See it <accent>in action</accent>
landing.body: Play, track your progress, your library, your albums, your friends and your band: the whole app in one minute.
landing.installBody: No app store: it goes on your home screen in a minute, notifications included.
